summary: Archive continuity was checked only against the three supplied complete issues—Nostr Compass #38 (2026-09-02), #39 (2026-09-09), and #40 (2026-09-16)—and the #41 draft (2026-09-23). The Stage 4 selection memo was used only to identify claimed primary URLs, not as proof of novelty. Within that window, repeated projects (Grain, MDK, Amethyst, Amber, Dart NDK, Nostr Mail Client, Nail, pakstr, nostr-wot-extension, TWENTY ONE Companion, nostream, Divine Mobile, Zap Cooking, Conduit, Mostro, Ditto, NIP-A3, NWC, Marmot PR 423) each carry a new tag, merged PR, signed event, or open-to-merged transition; NIP-30 and NIP-71 do not reuse #38 NIP-18/25, #39 NIP-21/27, or #40 NIP-23/92. Limitations: #38 is truncated mid-nostrord; this snapshot has no issues before #38, so the draft's April RelayKit and January/April deep-dive callbacks cannot be verified here; a project name or generic repository URL was not treated as a new primary source.
